user.title: Solar-Forecast.com
user.description: Enter your API key. Optionally pick a production power sensor, and choose whether Home Assistant should upload that history to solar-forecast.com.

data_description.Sensor For Sending Production Data: Used for the Generation series on the dashboard. Also uploaded when sending is enabled.
data_description.send_generation_data: When enabled, sensor history is uploaded and the dashboard shows generation from solar-forecast.com. When disabled, the dashboard uses local sensor history only.
